title: Java labs with post-grade ChatGPT feedback variants
summary: Students complete four selected Java lab assignments and, after grades are released, receive two ChatGPT feedback variants generated with and without their source code. They compare the variants and evaluate the feedback's formative qualities.

sources.title: Students’ perceptions and preferences of generative artificial intelligence feedback for programming
sources.evidence_quote: generated automated feedback using the ChatGPT API for four lab assignments

assessment.summary: Complete Java labs involving strings, arithmetic, loops, and file processing, then review generated feedback.
student_actions: Implement and submit each Java lab.
Review failed tests and two AI-generated feedback messages after grading.
Select and explain a feedback preference in a survey.

outputs.artifact: Java code and feedback survey responses

student_role.description: ChatGPT generated personalized feedback after final grades; one prompt variant included student code and one excluded it.

grading.method: Existing GitHub/Gradescope course grading preceded the experimental feedback.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: 58 students consented; 23-28 answered each of four surveys, and 72.5% of responses preferred feedback grounded in their code.
